name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-12-15, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.85 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
